chronology: Initial prototype in May 2019; full game shipped December 2019.
The developer's financial account covers paid transactions separately from free download events and bundle access.
The developer described later updates changing sales timing, but there is no randomized causal effect measurement.
The 2020 budget distinguishes estimated value of owner/collaborator work from out-of-pocket cash transfers.
limitations: Australian dollars are assumed for budget/cost figures unless specified in the source. Positive payment average and recommended price are USD and must not be pooled without an actual FX date.
The source's raw 1.36% event ratio is not a measured share of unique downloaders who pay, and the doubled 2.72% is a hypothetical correction, not validated unique players.
Approximately 815k promotional bundle owners are neither separate title checkout orders nor individual full-price sale events.
Several cost categories are explicitly excluded or estimated as unpaid work; the report cannot give all-inclusive owner net profit.
The costed case is from one selected developer in a 2019–2020 game market, not a representative paid-newcomer income distribution or causal marketing experiment.
